capabilities: Set a solid color, linear or radial gradient, or image background for graph views
Choose an image from the vault or an external URL, with cover, contain, repeat, or center fit
Target the global graph, the local graph, or both
Adjust dim and blur overlays on the background layer without affecting graph nodes, links, or labels
extras: Manual install only (copy main.js, manifest.json, styles.css into the plugins folder); the description notes it has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. The README warns it depends on Obsidian's internal graph CSS classes, so a future Obsidian update could break it.
intentEvidence: Customize the background of Obsidian's global and local graph views — solid color, gradient, or image
problem: Obsidian's graph views have no built-in way to change their background without writing CSS snippets or switching themes.
summary: Graph view customization that sets a solid color, gradient, or image background behind Obsidian's global and local graph views from settings.
